model_assisted.heldout_meaning: Whole encoder openings test articulation projection. Fixed camera/body pose does not independently validate camera depth or hidden contact surfaces.

original_acquisition_provenance.heldout_meaning: Whole encoder openings test articulation projection. Fixed camera/body pose does not independently validate camera depth or hidden contact surfaces.

camera_revalidation.heldout_evaluation: retained under exact K/D/handeye/focal equivalence; not newly captured or refitted

contact_section.description: Common ray along nominal CAD +X at y=3mm, z=-80mm; continuous facing contact band y=2..4mm. Local insertion plane only, not an entire corridor or independently measured pads.

assumptions.description: Engineering assumption: 2 mm per pad for nominal printed CAD contact surface/hinge residual, not mechanically surveyed. Encoder/hysteresis allowance 8 ticks. Two-sigma conditional residual covariance with actual coherent edge/focal refit envelope as a floor, not a physical confidence guarantee.

validation.acceptance_basis: Engineering review after observing this capture: retained silhouette group P95 <= 15 pixels allows blurred printed-finger edges and manual contour placement. Coherent edge perturbations up to 15 pixels were propagated; this is not a preregistered threshold, metric accuracy, or contact certification.

model_assisted.uncertainty_combination: At each raw: max(conditional parameter spread, same-image refit sensitivity) + separately identified independent parameter-family sensitivity + encoder sensitivity + declared CAD/hinge pad assumption; maximum over measured encoder ticks. Base/FK uncertainty is separate.

conditional_covariance.interpretation: Conditional training-residual linearization. Contour correspondence, CAD accuracy and correlated pixels require separate declared assumptions/sensitivity checks; this is not external metric accuracy.
